Source-reviewed orchestration. Nested semantics remain open; no runtime acceptance
claimed. Complete installer source reviewed without running it or contacting GitHub for
registration. Failure retains earlier user/group/files/registration/service changes. Path
checks inspect the supplied final path and do not canonicalize symlink ancestors. A
matching distribution marker does not rehash every extracted executable. GitHub online
status is not a completed workflow acceptance test.
